members.title: Demo allowlist blocks an unknown recipient
members.objective:
## Submit a recipient outside the allowlist
Stay in "Demo (mock)" mode. Do not click Connect wallet. Set the "Recipient" field to Mallory and keep the amount at 12. Click "Check against rails". Verify the page says this recipient is not on the allowed list, the referee status is "Blocked", the receipt explains that the recipient is not on the demo allowlist, and there is no "Approve" button.

checks.check: Checking for the recipient allow-list notice
checks.condition: the page says this recipient is not on the allowed list
checks.expected: the page message that this recipient is not on the allowed list present

checks.condition: the receipt explains that the recipient is not on the demo allowlist
checks.expected: the receipt explanation that the recipient is not on the demo allowlist present

checks.check: Checking whether the Approve button is present

members.title: A blocked payment says "Blocked" everywhere
members.objective:
## Block an unknown recipient and read every status
Stay in "Demo (mock)" mode. Do not click Connect wallet. Set the "Recipient" field to Mallory and keep the amount at 12. Click "Check against rails". The rails must block this proposal, and the user must see one consistent word for it. Verify all of these: the TapeOut policy circuit rule says "Blocked"; the status pill next to the "Referee decision" heading says exactly "Blocked" (not "Refused" or any other word); the receipt's decision line says "Blocked"; and there is no "Approve" button.

checks.check: Checking whether the proposal is blocked by the rails
checks.expected: the proposal blocked by the rails present

checks.check: Checking the consistency of the blocked decision word
checks.condition: The user sees one consistent word for the blocked proposal decision.
checks.expected: one consistent word for the blocked proposal decision present

checks.check: Reading the TapeOut policy circuit decision
checks.condition: The TapeOut policy circuit rule says "Blocked".

checks.check: Reading the Referee decision status pill
checks.condition: The status pill next to the "Referee decision" heading says exactly "Blocked" (not "Refused" or any other word).

checks.check: Checking whether the Approve button is present

members.title: Policy circuit shows Approved, Needs your OK, and Blocked
members.objective:
## Change the amount and recipient in demo mode
Stay in "Demo (mock)" mode. Do not click Connect wallet. With the default recipient Alex and amount 12, verify the TapeOut policy circuit rule says "Needs your OK". Change the amount to 5 and verify the circuit rule says "Approved". Change the amount to 21 and verify the circuit rule says "Blocked". Set the amount back to 12, change the recipient to Mallory, and verify the circuit rule says "Blocked".

checks.check: Reading the TapeOut policy circuit rule verdict
checks.condition: With the default recipient Alex and amount 12, the TapeOut policy circuit rule says "Needs your OK".

checks.check: Reading the TapeOut policy circuit rule status
checks.condition: The TapeOut policy circuit rule says "Approved".

checks.check: Reading the TapeOut policy circuit rule status
checks.condition: The TapeOut policy circuit rule says "Blocked".

checks.check: Reading the TapeOut policy circuit verdict
checks.condition: The TapeOut policy circuit rule says "Blocked".
